company.description:
Garten is a technology wellness company that has partnered with the most innovative companies in the world like Apple, Amazon, Google, Lyft and more. Offering a full suite of wellness services such as food, yoga, and meditation; the company aims to empower the workplace and lead people to make healthier, smarter choices across nutrition, exercise, rest, detox, and overall wellbeing. The company's mission is to empower people to live healthy and blissful lives. 

Founder Michael Heinrich was inspired in his youth in Berlin, Germany where his Grandmother cultivated an organic garden and as a medical doctor, she would emphasize that if you want to stay healthy keep good wellbeing habits like healthy food, good sleep, friends, daily exercise and more. Michael took this to heart and started Garten.
